# ML4WX: machine learning for weather & climate

A living, searchable archive of machine learning and AI research for weather and climate,
updated every week from arXiv, journals and lab blogs.

## How it works

1. **Every week** (Monday morning, Zurich time) a GitHub Action searches arXiv and OpenAlex for
   new papers, classifies them with Claude (relevance, topic, method, time scale, data), detects
   the organizations, and opens a pull request. A maintainer reviews and merges it.
2. **Every day** the same pipeline checks for important new work (top labs, top venues, major
   results) and opens a `highlight` issue, so watchers get an email the same day.
3. The site is rebuilt on every merge.

A paper is in scope when machine learning is a main contribution **and** the main target is the
atmosphere or the climate system. The full rule and the topic list are in
[`config/taxonomy.yaml`](config/taxonomy.yaml).

## Use the data

- One YAML file per paper in [`papers/`](papers/) (schema: [`src/ml4wx/models.py`](src/ml4wx/models.py))
- [`exports/papers.bib`](exports/papers.bib) (BibTeX) and [`exports/papers.csv`](exports/papers.csv)

## Contribute

Missing paper or wrong label? [Open an issue](https://github.com/ml4wx/ml4wx.github.io/issues/new)
with the arXiv id or DOI, or edit the paper's YAML file and open a pull request.
